verdict.rationale: Sketch's docs say Libraries and reusable components are built in the Mac app. Starring a version in a Library document publishes it as a Library update to everyone using that Library, and unstarred versions do not become updates, which gives explicit control over updates. Community users independently praise Sketch's symbols and libraries for design-system work. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that shared text/color styles (not just Symbols) are published through Libraries, explicit evidence of cross-project library scope, and detail on how consumers review or accept incoming updates.
